cases.translation: I looked and saw the lamb.
cases.explain: The verb увидел (saw) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object.
The preposition на (on) governing location uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: I heard a sound from heaven.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) governing source uses the genitive case.

cases.translation: They sing a new song before the throne.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: На его голове был золотой венец, и в ___ он держал острый серп.
cases.translation: On his head was a golden crown, and in his hand he held a sharp sickle.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing location uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: The harvest was gathered from the earth.
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the passive verb собран (was gathered) and stands in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Ангел вышел от ___, где он заведовал огнем.
cases.translation: Another angel came out from the altar, where he had power over the fire.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Виноград был потоптан в ___ Божьей ярости.
cases.translation: The grapes were trampled in the winepress of God's wrath.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing location uses the prepositional case.

reading.question: What did the speaker see?
reading.explain: The text says Я посмотрел и увидел ягненка (I looked and saw the lamb).

reading.ru: Он стоял на горе Сион, и с ним было сто сорок четыре тысячи человек.
reading.question: How many people stood with the lamb on Mount Zion?
reading.explain: The text states сто сорок четыре тысячи человек (144,000 people).

reading.ru: Я слышал шум с небес, он напоминал одновременно шум могучих вод, раскаты сильного грома и звук, который производят арфисты.
reading.question: What three things did the sound from heaven resemble?
reading.explain: The text describes the sound as like шум могучих вод (mighty waters), раскаты грома (peals of thunder), and звук арфистов (the sound of harpists).

reading.ru: Они были искуплены из всего человечества и освящены как первые плоды для Бога и ягненка.
reading.question: What were the 144,000 called in relation to God and the Lamb?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states первые плоды (first fruits) for Бога и ягненка.

reading.ru: В их словах не нашлось никакой лжи, они непорочны.
reading.question: What was special about what the 144,000 said?
options: No lie was found in their words
reading.correct: No lie was found in their words
reading.explain: The text says В их словах не нашлось никакой лжи (No lie was found in their words).

reading.ru: Я посмотрел и увидел белое облако.
reading.question: What did the speaker see when looking again?
reading.explain: The text says Я посмотрел и увидел белое облако (I looked and saw a white cloud).
